description: This file defines API routes for handling payment-related operations in a food delivery backend service, including creating and confirming mock payment intents.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router for defining API endpoints related to payments.

methods.name: PaymentIntentOut _pi_out(pi: PaymentIntent)
methods.description: Converts a PaymentIntent ORM object to its schema representation PaymentIntentOut.

methods.name: CreatePaymentIntentResponse create_payment_intent( order_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a mock payment intent for an order, or returns an existing one, and updates order status accordingly.

methods.name: PaymentIntentOut confirm_payment( order_id: int, payload: ConfirmPaymentRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Confirms a mock payment intent using client_secret, updates statuses, and returns the PaymentIntentOut object.

ctags.name: confirm_payment
ctags.signature: ( order_id: int, payload: ConfirmPaymentRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: create_payment_intent
ctags.signature: ( order_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
